lamps.lamp: Immobilizer/keyless push start system warning light
lamps.steady: There is a problem with the immobilizer or keyless push start system; have it inspected by an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: The engine will not start; turn ignition to LOCK then back to ON, or check key/system.

lamps.steady: The fuel is low; fill the fuel tank immediately.
Brake fluid is low or parking brake is engaged. Pull over carefully and check brakes, or release parking brake.
There is a problem with the ABS. Pull over, restart the engine, and if it stays on, have it inspected.
Insufficient oil pressure. Pull off the road immediately, stop the engine, check oil level, and add oil.
There is a problem with the battery charging system; have it inspected immediately by an authorized workshop.
Driver or front passenger has not buckled their seat belt.
lamps.flashing: Driver or front passenger has not buckled their seat belt.

lamps.lamp: Rear Passenger's Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: Rear passengers have not fastened their seat belts.
There is a problem in the airbag or seat belt pretensioner system; have it inspected immediately.
lamps.flashing: Working normally during check, or indicates system problem if it continues.

lamps.steady: There is damage in the emission control system or a problem with the Auto Gear Shift system; have it serviced.
lamps.flashing: Misfire detected in the engine; stop vehicle immediately in a safe place to avoid catalyst damage.

lamps.steady: There is a problem with the Auto Gear Shift system; have it inspected.
lamps.flashing: Auto Gear Shift clutch temperature is too high; stop the vehicle in a safe place and let it cool down.

lamps.steady: A door or the tailgate is completely open.
The engine is still cold.
lamps.flashing: There is a problem with the system; have your vehicle inspected.

lamps.lamp: High engine coolant temperature warning light
lamps.steady: The engine is overheating; follow overheating emergency instructions.
lamps.flashing: The engine is running hot; avoid driving conditions leading to overheating.

lamps.steady: Front fog lights are operating.

lamps.flashing: Left or right turn signals or hazard warning lights are active (fast blinking indicates a turn signal malfunction).

lamps.steady: Headlight main beams (high beams) are turned on.

lamps.flashing: There may be a problem with the security system; have it inspected.

lamps.steady: Depress the brake pedal for Auto Gear Shift operation.
You can start the engine by depressing the brake or clutch pedal.
lamps.flashing: Remote controller not sensed or ignition modes cannot be selected.

lamps.steady: Ignition mode is set to ACC.
Ignition mode is set to ON with the engine off.

lamps.lamp: Keyless Push Start System Remote Controller Battery Consumption Warning Light
lamps.steady: The remote controller battery is low or unreliable.
The engine has been stopped automatically by the ENG A-STOP system.
lamps.flashing: There is a malfunction in the ENG A-STOP system, or the battery has discharged/pressure dropped.

lamps.steady: The ENG A-STOP system has been deactivated using the switch.
lamps.flashing: There is something wrong with the ENG A-STOP system; have it inspected.

lamps.steady: CNG fuel is low; fill the CNG tank immediately.
There may be a problem with the hill hold control system; have it inspected.
Steering lock is not disengaged; gently turn the steering wheel and press the engine switch.
There is something wrong with the ESP system; have it inspected.
lamps.flashing: Stability control or traction control system is currently activated; drive carefully.

lamps.steady: ESP systems (other than ABS) have been turned off using the ESP OFF switch.
